name: McCall Farm B&B
description: McCall Farm B&B grows Apples, Plums, Oranges, Avocados, and Pumpkins in Cambria, CA. The farm is independent, and its seasons run through autumn, summer, and winter. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Aug – Nov in this growing zone.
